title: Canonical ready seam computation
statement: There are a finite Turing machine $C$ over the Boolean alphabet, entry and exit states, and a natural number $a$, with at least four work tapes, such that for every Boolean word $\alpha$ there is a time $t\le a(|\alpha|+1)$ at which the run from the configuration with state equal to the entry state, input $\alpha$, blank work tapes, and empty output has not reached the exit state at any earlier time and equals the configuration with state equal to the exit state, input head at position $1$, empty output, and tape contents given by the canonical ready words for the canonical header of $\alpha$, with all work-tape heads at position zero.
hypotheses_covered: exit state is not reached earlier
final configuration equals the specified canonical ready seam
